en.title: Downloading Official Result Books
en.excerpt: How to compile and export comprehensive World Archery compliant PDF Result Books for tournament archives.
en.content:
Result Book Components

The Official Result Book is the master archive of an archery tournament. Archeris automatically formats all event data into a standardized multi-page PDF document containing:

  • Title Page & Organizing Committee: Official event branding and committee leadership list.
  • Participant Roster: Complete list of archers grouped by club and category.
  • Target Allocation Records: Initial butt positioning matrix.
  • Qualification Results: End-by-end scoring tables with 10s, Xs, and total point tallies.
  • Elimination Match Trees: Complete graphic brackets from 1/32 Round through Finals.
  • Medal Standings: Gold, Silver, and Bronze medal tallies per club.

Generating the Document

Navigate to Tournament Dashboard > Reports > click Download Result Book (PDF). The system compiles all tables into a print-ready document.

Official Federation Submission

The generated PDF complies with World Archery and national federation reporting guidelines for official ranking submissions and record validations.
